### SR UNIVERSITY

### SCHOOL OF COMPUTER SCIENCE & ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE

### B.TECH COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING - SEMESTER VII (R23)

### 1. Course Structure: Semester VII

The seventh semester of B.Tech CSE comprises core courses, professional electives, and capstone project work:

- Course 23CS401: Deep Learning & Neural Architectures (Credits: 3 | L-T-P: 3-0-0)

- Course 23CS402: Cloud Computing & Distributed Systems (Credits: 3 | L-T-P: 3-0-0)

- Course 23CS403: Capstone Project Phase-I (Credits: 4 | L-T-P: 0-0-8)

- Course 23CS411: Professional Elective V - Natural Language Processing & RAG Systems (Credits: 3 | L-T-P: 3-0-0)

### 2. Detailed Course Syllabi

### 23CS401: Deep Learning & Neural Architectures

- Unit I: Feedforward Neural Networks, Gradient Descent, Backpropagation, Optimization Algorithms (Adam, RMSProp).

- Unit II: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), ResNet, Object Detection architectures.

- Unit III: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), LSTMs, GRUs, Sequence-to-Sequence models.

- Unit IV: Attention Mechanisms, Transformer Architecture, Self-Attention, Multi-Head Attention, Vision Transformers.

- Unit V: Generative Models: Autoencoders, VAEs, GANs, Diffusion Models.

Textbooks:

1. Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville, "Deep Learning", MIT Press.

### 23CS402: Cloud Computing & Distributed Systems

- Unit I: Virtualization and Containerization, Hypervisors, Docker container architecture.

- Unit II: Cloud Service Models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Deployment Models (Public, Private, Hybrid).

- Unit III: Cloud Infrastructure Orchestration: Kubernetes, Pods, Services, Deployments.

- Unit IV: Serverless Computing, Microservices architecture, API Gateways, Load Balancing.

- Unit V: Cloud Security, IAM policies, Encryption at rest and in transit, Disaster Recovery.

### 23CS403: Capstone Project Phase-I

- Objective: Formulate, design, and execute an original engineering project addressing real-world institutional or industry challenges.

- Deliverables:

1. Title and Abstract Approval (Submission Form signed by Project Guide).

2. Literature Review and Feasibility Analysis.

3. System Architecture and Component Specifications.

4. Working Prototype and Evaluation Benchmark.

- Team Allocation: Team 235 - Project Title: "SRU Assistant: A RAG Framework for University Academic Query Resolution".

- Evaluation: Guide Evaluation (30 Marks), Department Evaluation Committee Review (30 Marks), End-Semester Viva-Voce (40 Marks). Total: 100 Marks.

### 23CS411: Natural Language Processing & RAG Systems

- Unit I: Text Representation, Tokenization, TF-IDF, Word2Vec, GloVe, Subword Tokenization.

- Unit II: Transformer-based Language Models, BERT, RoBERTa, GPT models, Fine-tuning strategies.

- Unit III: Dense Passage Retrieval, Vector Databases, SQLite, FAISS, Cosine Similarity, Approximate Nearest Neighbors.

- Unit IV: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG): Dense and Lexical Retrieval, BM25, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), Cross-Encoder Re-ranking.

- Unit V: Grounded Generation, Hallucination Prevention, Citation Construction, Evaluation Metrics (Faithfulness, Answer Relevance).
